text: Wilson Heights Boulevard, south of Sheppard Avenue West, is classified as minor arterial street. It has a regulatory speed limit of 50 km/h and a daily two-way traffic volume of approximately 25,000 vehicles. It consists of two lanes in each direction and there are exclusive left-turn lanes provided at the signalized intersections with Sheppard Avenue West and Reiner Road. There are sidewalks provided on both sides of the street. There is no TTC service provided on this section of Wilson Heights Boulevard. The section of Wilson Heights Boulevard, between Sheppard Avenue West and Reiner Road, is approximately 340 metres in length. The southern portion of this street section is comprised of single family homes that have driveways directly onto Wilson Heights Boulevard.
